create_MultiValue: create a MultiValue instance to track mean, variance, and confidence bounds across multiple evaluations of a parameter
build_Archive: build an Archive dict-like object to store numpy array keys mapped to MultiValue evaluation results
test_Pruning: test the Pruning callable to trim an optimizer archive by keeping the best points across optimistic, pessimistic, and average criteria
review_UidQueue: review the UidQueue class to manage asked and told UID queues for population-based optimization workflows
refactor_ConstraintManager: refactor the ConstraintManager to compute penalty values for parameters that violate constraint checkers during optimization
